title: The 8 Best Double Sided Tape for Woodworking 2026
h1: The 8 Best Double Sided Tape for Woodworking 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for double sided tape for woodworking 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at double sided tape for woodworking 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: IPG Double-Sided Indoor Carpet Tape, 1.88-Inch x 36 Yards
products.blurb: Key specs: Long-time woodworker favorite for template and jig work, Strong initial tack, Removable without soaking hardware.
strengths: High tack holds templates and jigs firmly against routing and CNC forces
Cloth-reinforced backing resists curling and conforms to minor surface irregularities between template and workpiece
Peels off cleanly on most finished wood surfaces with minimal residue
Widely stocked at hardware and flooring suppliers -- easy to find in a pinch
limitations: Not marketed specifically for woodworking, so tack levels vary by batch
Wide 1.88-inch roll is more than needed for small templates
features: Long-time woodworker favorite for template and jig work
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: 3M Removable Repositionable Tape 665
products.blurb: Key specs: Repositionable adhesive, Low tack for easy removal, Works on most surfaces.
strengths: Repositionable adhesive allows moving the template to reposition before final placement
Low tack removes cleanly from finished wood without pulling fibers or leaving residue
Thin carrier minimizes the gap between template and workpiece
Available in wide rolls for large template coverage
limitations: Lower holding power than full-adhesive double-sided tape -- not for high-force routing
Repositionable tack may not hold templates securely on vertical surfaces

products.name: Duck Brand Indoor/Outdoor Carpet Tape
products.blurb: Key specs: Very strong adhesive, Holds carpet to floor, Works on rough surfaces.
strengths: Strongest holding power available in an off-the-shelf double-sided tape
Works on rough, unfinished wood surfaces where other tapes would not bond
Very inexpensive per foot -- economical for large template coverage areas
Available in home improvement stores nationally
limitations: Leaves adhesive residue -- requires solvent cleanup on finished surfaces
Not designed for woodworking -- residue can damage finish

products.name: Gorilla Heavy Duty Double Sided Mounting Tape
products.blurb: Key specs: Holds up to 30 lb, Clean removal, 1-inch width, sold in multi-packs.
strengths: Strong enough to hold small shop fixtures and sacrificial bases to workpieces
Cleaner removal than carpet tape
Sold in multi-packs, so extra rolls are always on hand for shop fixtures
Works on both wood and aluminum router plates and fixtures
limitations: Adhesive may leave residue on some finished surfaces
features: Works on wood, metal, and plastic

products.name: IPG 591 Premium Grade Double Coated Flatback Tape
products.blurb: Key specs: Bleached flatback paper carrier, High shear-resistant natural rubber and resin adhesive, Bonds well to nearly any material.
strengths: Flatback paper carrier is a proven industrial standard for high-shear double-sided bonding
High-tack adhesive holds templates securely against routing forces
Bonds well to both smooth and moderately textured workpiece surfaces
Industrial grade performs consistently across temperature ranges
limitations: Not foam -- does not conform to deep grain texture and knots as well as a foam carrier tape
Higher price than basic film double-sided tape
features: High shear-resistant natural rubber and resin adhesive
Bonds well to nearly any material

products.name: Scotch-Mount Extreme Double-Sided Mounting Tape 414H
products.blurb: Key specs: Foam carrier, Holds up to 30 lb, Works on smooth wood, metal, and plastic.
strengths: Good balance of holding power and removal cleanliness on smooth wood surfaces
3M industrial adhesive is a well-proven general-purpose bonding formula
Weather resistant, so it also works for exterior shop fixtures
Widely available general-purpose double-sided tape from a trusted brand
limitations: Foam carrier adds more thickness than a thin film tape
Overkill (and pricier) for light-duty layout work
features: Works on smooth wood, metal, and plastic

products.name: T-Rex Strong Hold Clear Double Sided Mounting Tape
products.blurb: Key specs: High-tack adhesive, Works on unfinished and finished wood, Clean removal.
strengths: High tack is adequate for stack cutting (stacking multiple workpieces and cutting simultaneously)
Works on both finished and unfinished wood surfaces
Clean removal makes it practical for holding parts during glue-up and assembly
Clear formula leaves no visible tape line along glue-up seams
limitations: Not as strong as foam carrier tapes for aggressive router work
Narrower 1-inch width requires more tape strips for large template coverage
features: Works on unfinished and finished wood

products.name: Gorilla Tough & Clear Double Sided Mounting Tape
products.blurb: Key specs: Clear, invisible bond line, High tack acrylic adhesive, Works on jig components, MDF, and plywood.
strengths: Clear formula is optimized for jig fixtures and hold-downs where a visible tape line is undesirable
High tack holds MDF and plywood jig templates against the workpiece during drilling and routing
Works on MDF, plywood, and solid wood
Gorilla brand ensures a consistent, dependable formula across rolls
limitations: Specialty clear formula costs more per foot than basic tape for the same holding power
Clear film can be harder to see and trim precisely than opaque tape
features: Works on jig components, MDF, and plywood

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
